statement: There is a complementary linear section of SO(4) consisting of forty real points. The construction imposes four zero diagonal entries and the two explicitly displayed homogeneous hyperplanes H1,H2; its forty matrices are listed, attaining deg SO(4)=40.

source.location: Theorem 4.1; Section 4, displayed hyperplanes H1,H2 and forty matrices

notes:
Does not prove total reality for SO(5).
